<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—M+1 intensity ~6.7% of the monoisotopic peak, consistent with ~6 carbons (≈1.1 % per 13C), and the rapid decline of higher‑mass peaks—we can definitively identify carbon as the element responsible for the pattern. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic signature (e.g., Cl, Br, S) at the observed intensities.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
